name: Ingenuity
location: "Valinor Hills", Neretva Vallis, Jezero crater (approximate position)
tagline: I was supposed to fly 5 times. I flew 72 times on Mars.
discovery: I proved that a vehicle could fly in the Martian air, about 100 times thinner than Earth's. I also scouted ahead for the Perseverance rover by photographing the terrain from the sky.
status_note: After my 72nd flight in January 2024, one of my rotor blades was damaged. I can no longer fly, but I remain in Jezero crater.

presentation.title: Hello, I'm Ingenuity.
presentation.body: I'm a helicopter from the Mars 2020 mission. I was supposed to fly 5 times. I flew 72 times on Mars.

chapters.title: A quiet passenger
chapters.body: I travelled to Mars tucked under the belly of the Perseverance rover. I weigh about 1.8 kg. My two rotors spin in opposite directions at more than 2,400 revolutions per minute to push against very thin air.

chapters.title: The first flight
chapters.body: On 19 April 2021, I take off, climb to 3 metres, hover and land again. The flight lasts only 39 seconds, but it is the very first powered, controlled flight on another planet.

chapters.title: From demonstrator to scout
chapters.body: At first, I was only supposed to make 5 test flights. I worked so well that the team kept me for almost three years: 72 flights, more than 17 km covered and over two hours in the Martian sky.

chapters.title: A hard landing
chapters.body: On my 72nd flight, I fly over very smooth sand with no landmarks to guide my navigation camera. I land hard and my blades are damaged. My adventure in the sky ends there, but I paved the way for future flying machines, like Dragonfly, which is to explore Titan, a moon of Saturn.

quiz.question: How many flights was Ingenuity originally supposed to make?
quiz.explanation: It was meant to make 5 demonstration flights. It made 72!

quiz.question: Why is it hard to fly on Mars?
choices: The air is about 100 times thinner than on Earth
quiz.explanation: With so little air, the blades must be large, light and spin very fast.
